description: This file defines a singleton object 'RepositoryProvider' that provides factory methods to obtain various repository instances (ProfileRepository, ConnectionRepository, TransferHistoryRepository) backed by a Room database in an Android application. It acts as a centralized provider for repository instantiation, ensuring proper database initialization.

classes.name: RepositoryProvider
classes.description: A singleton object that offers factory methods for obtaining repositories backed by a Room database.

methods.name: profileRepository
methods.description: Creates and returns a ProfileRepository instance using the Room database.

methods.name: connectionRepository
methods.description: Creates and returns a ConnectionRepository instance using the Room database.

methods.name: transferHistoryRepository
methods.description: Creates and returns a TransferHistoryRepository instance using the Room database.
